status: FROZEN before tail30th2000 or tail3rd2000 was trained. The SHA-256 of this file is recorded in the commit that froze it. Amendments only before any result is seen.
title: With a hard 20 mm threshold, does the calibrated gain depend on the dose?
origin: evaluation/variants_testyear_plan.json registered that a hard 20 mm threshold would carry no calibrated gain. It was contradicted: tailA2000 (hard 20 mm, weight 1 371.6, a tenth of the original) gained -0.00133 [-0.00194, -0.00083] at 20 mm against control2000, while tail2000 (the same term at the full weight 13 716) gained -0.00014 [-0.00082, +0.00048]. The two differ only in weight. This plan adds two doses to the series, on a log scale, and states in advance what a dose effect should look like.

models.tail30th2000: bris/train/finetune_tail_a30.yaml: hard threshold 20 mm, weight 457.2 (1/30 of 13 716), step 2000 of the 3 000-step schedule, seed 20260909
models.tail3rd2000: bris/train/finetune_tail_a3.yaml: hard threshold 20 mm, weight 4 572 (1/3), step 2000, seed 20260909
models.already_scored: tailA2000 (1/10) and tail2000 (1) on the test year, ~/bris-runs/variants-testyear

training: one run each, bris/slurm/finetune.sbatch, nothing changed but the weight. A run lost to the node is restarted from the beginning, unchanged.
test: exactly as evaluation/variants_testyear_plan.json: 2025-08-01..2026-09-06, 4 members, BRIS_LEADTIMES=7, +30 h, strict common cases of the arm, control2000 and MEPS, scripts/hits_and_calibration.py --cv month --replicates 5000 --meps, each arm as its own pair against control2000

endpoint_per_arm.measure: Brier score at 20 mm after month-out isotonic calibration, arm minus control2000
endpoint_per_arm.uncertainty: paired block bootstrap, seven-day blocks, 5000 replicates

registered_prediction.hypothesis: the gain falls with dose: present at small and moderate weights, gone at the full weight
registered_prediction.tail3rd2000: a mean difference closer to zero than tailA2000's -0.00133
registered_prediction.supported_if: tail30th2000 better, and tail3rd2000's mean difference above -0.00133
registered_prediction.contradicted_if: tail30th2000 not better, or tail3rd2000's mean difference at or below -0.00133

secondary_reported: the four-point series 1/30, 1/10, 1/3, 1 at 10, 20 and 50 mm, with raw Brier, ROC area and frequency bias, as a figure against log dose
tail3rd2000 minus tailA2000, calibrated, at 20 mm, on their common cases (paired bootstrap)
not_claimed: One draw per dose, at step 2000, one threshold. A dose curve for the hard threshold only; the arms without a threshold are not part of it.
